topic: Goal-based investing: child's education, house, wedding, retirement

slides.headline: One question to ask before any investment
slides.subhead: What is this money for, and when will you need it?

slides.title: Match the goal to the time

points.title: Under 3 years
points.text: Short goals usually need stability and easy access to your money.

points.title: 3 to 7 years
points.text: Mid-term goals, like a house down payment, need a balanced view.

points.title: 7 years or more
points.text: Long goals, like retirement, can stay invested through market ups and downs.

slides.headline: Name the goal. Then plan the time.
slides.cta: Save this for your next goal chat
slides.footnote: General education, not advice for any individual.

caption: Before choosing any investment, ask what the money is for and when you will need it. A child's education, a home and retirement all have different time frames. Start with the goal. #GoalBasedInvesting #MutualFunds #FamilyGoals #Chennai #TamilNadu
